ValidationRule.description: Cannot move Opp stage to Closed Won unless Approval status is "Approved" on Opportunity. BOPI-526 Removed Agents from this validation. They will not use CPQ or sbaa BOPI-600 updated to prevent auto renewals from stopping
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(sbaa__ApprovalStatus__c, "Approved")), ISCHANGED(StageName), OR( RecordType.Name = 'B2B', RecordType.Name = 'Education', RecordType.Name = 'Healthcare', RecordType.Name = 'Travel' ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Auto Renewal")), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> "B - Looker", $User.Alias <> "Workato" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Click Submit for Approval button. Once fully approved, the Opportunity Stage will automatically change to Closed Won
